gbifID.description: Unique global biodiversity record identifier assigned by GBIF for each observation.

datasetKey.description: Constant UUID identifying the source dataset for all observations.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URL linking to iNaturalist record for each bird sighting.

kingdom.description: Biological kingdom classification, uniformly Animalia for all records.

phylum.description: All observations belong to the animal phylum Chordata.

class.description: All records belong to the avian class Aves.

order.description: The taxonomic order of the bird observations, always Passeriformes.

family.description: Taxonomic family of the observed bird, consistently Ploceidae.

genus.description: Genus of the observed bird species is Euplectes.

species.description: Species name of the observed bird, always Euplectes progne.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Taxonomic subspecies designation for Euplectes progne observations.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the observation, either species or subspecies.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the observed bird, including subspecies and authority.

verbatimScientificName.description: Original taxonomic designation recorded for each observation, including subspecies variants.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship field, currently empty for all observations.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166‑1 alpha‑2 code identifying observation country.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Province in South Africa where each bird observation was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: Observation status indicating the bird was present at the recorded location.

individualCount.description: Individual count of birds observed per record, currently missing for all entries.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published each observation record.

decimalLatitude.description: Observation latitude in decimal degrees, ranging from southern to near‑equatorial locations.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude of each observation expressed in decimal degrees.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of observation location measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision is unspecified for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data is missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation measurement accuracy is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth data missing for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy measurement is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each Euplectes progne record, ranging from 1986 to 2026.

day.description: Day of month when observation was recorded.

month.description: Observation month (1‑12) of the recorded bird sighting.

year.description: Observation year of the record, ranging from 1986 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier code linking each observation to a specific Euplectes progne taxon.

speciesKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for Euplectes progne observations.

basisOfRecord.description: Human observation record type for each bird sighting.

institutionCode.description: Observation source identifier, uniformly iNaturalist across all records.

collectionCode.description: Dataset collection identifier consistently set to “Observations” for all records.

catalogNumber.description: Unique observation identifier assigned by the collection database.

recordNumber.description: Missing identifier for each observation, currently absent.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded the bird observation.

dateIdentified.description: Observation identification timestamp recorded in UTC datetime format.

license.description: Data usage license applied to each observation.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder names of observers contributing bird occurrence records.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each bird observation.

typeStatus.description: No information provided for type status.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means information is unavailable for all observations.

lastInterpreted.description: Date and time when observation was last interpreted, recorded to microsecond precision.

mediaType.description: Media type of each observation, specifying format such as still image.

issue.description: Quality flags for observations: coordinate rounded with continent derived, or continent derived only.

euplectes_progne.description: 1001 Euplectes progne observations (2002‑2026) with taxonomic, temporal, geographic, and observer metadata.

description: Records 1001 bird observations of Euplectes progne from 2002 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
